items: pinch of chilli or chilli flakes
Cut up the onion and fry it alongside whole tomatoes over medium heat with a bit of oil.
Once the onion is done, add garlic and spices for 60s.
Move everything from a pan into a pot, and add canned tomatoes, sugar, cube and water.
Simmer for a few minutes, optionally add a bit of tomato paste.
Add a bit of heavy cream, mix and let cool off enough for blending, then blend.
Bring back to a simmer, adjust spices, sugar and acidity to taste.
Add a bit of butter into a pan.
While that melts, prepare the bread with a slice of each type of cheese.
Fry on low-medium heat until browned on both sides, add more butter if needed.
Plate the soup, add a teaspoon of heavy cream in the middle, shape it into a swirl.
Add a top few leaves of a basil on top.
Cut grilled cheese in half and serve while still piping hot.
